Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes contact with Jokic's (DEN) front that affects his FOM and ability to establish post position.
Jokic (DEN) sets the pick on Fox (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.

Cauley-Stein (SAC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Beasley (DEN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
